name: Vale
greeting: We said we would speak again if the words stopped being true. I'm listening.
lines: Vale: Whatever this answer is, it won't rewrite the record, or what we were to each other.

actions.label: I cannot keep our commitment. I'm ending it honestly.

relationship_event.text: Kael ended his commitment to Vale in direct conversation. Their past remains part of the record.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: We do not need to pretend none of it happened. We do need room for what comes next.
